description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode] and [Crystal Force Mode: Reynn (Ice)] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: One single attack (19.50) capped at 199,999, grants [Magical +20% Boost 1] to all allies, grants [Damage Cap +10000 1], [Instant Cast 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1] and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force II

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Reynn (Ice)
description.text: Ice abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions
